publicReleaseNotes:
- **Maintenance notices follow the transition.** Starting a window sends its start notice and completing it sends its completion notice. The public status page lists upcoming maintenance through the fourteen-day boundary.
- **Component states and times are easier to read.** Lamp uses Working, Slow, Partly down, Down and Maintenance for component states. Times show a familiar zone name, such as New York time. Open Time details on the public page for exact UTC offsets. Settings → Page gives Time zone details a full-size control.
- **The public status page starts with the first published snapshot.** The page, Atom feed and widget report that status is unavailable until Lamp has published its first snapshot. After an operator publishes a new update, a request carrying the previous snapshot’s cache validator gets the current content.
- **Technical archives restore into an empty local installation.** Lamp skips rer’s internal bookkeeping tables when exporting and restoring, so those tables no longer prevent a local restore.
- **Verify old bookmarks during Cutover.** Lamp checks that each legacy bookmark redirects to the expected Lamp page and reports an unexpected destination, an unavailable page or an unreachable address.
- **Reconcile notifications in the Delivery log.** The CSV covers the full set of deliveries matching the active filters. If a subscriber delivery fails and can be retried, Lamp schedules up to five retries over one hour.
- **Local invitation guidance explains where links work.** An operator can open a pending invitation in the same browser. To send a teammate an invitation they can open elsewhere, invite them from the online copy with email enabled.
- **The checkout uses rer 0.2.125.**

### Upgrading from 1.11.23

Back up data and your source changes first. Update the checkout to `v1.11.24`, run `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and run `rer deploy` with the same environment and input file. This version adds no migrations. Keep the backup and exercise a restored copy. Check sign-in, first-run setup, Settings, incident publication, maintenance notices and your intended mail configuration. Review imported Sorry templates before using them. Preserve the original deployment checkout, ownership records and account credentials for `rer signin`. Earlier installations also follow the retained upgrade notes below, including the migration introduced in 1.11.17, the mail-off instructions in 1.11.19 and keeping `INSTALLATION_KEY` with their private secrets.

### Known limits

Use the source revision that created a technical archive for the initial restore, then update the restored copy normally. Restore into an empty destination. The existing accessibility evaluation covers selected journeys and leaves some WCAG 2.2 AA criteria unevaluated.

PAGE-009.summary: Public screens name the configured time zone, with exact UTC offsets available in Time details.
PAGE-009.was: Public timestamps and notifications use the configured time zone and offset. Under RL-1, the owner’s S4 exception permits a relative generation label while scripting runs. 1. Every public and notification timestamp displays the configured time zone and UTC offset; page timestamps retain their exact ISO instant as machine-readable data. 2. With scripting available, the generation label is relative and refreshes while the page stays open; its tooltip retains the absolute configured-zone time and offset and its machine-readable value retains the instant. 3. Initial HTML and script-disabled readers see the absolute generation time; incident, maintenance, feed and notification timestamps remain absolute.
PAGE-009.now: Public timestamps use the configured time zone, named on the page with exact UTC offsets available in Time details. Feeds and notifications retain absolute timestamps with the configured offset. Under RL-1, the owner’s S4 exception permits a relative generation label while scripting runs. 1. Public page timestamps use the configured zone’s local time and name, with exact UTC offsets in Time details and ISO instants as machine-readable data. Feed and notification timestamps retain the configured UTC offset. 2. With scripting available, the generation label is relative and refreshes while the page stays open. Its tooltip gives the absolute configured-zone time, Time details gives the offset, and its machine-readable value retains the instant. 3. Initial HTML and script-disabled readers see the absolute generation time; incident, maintenance, feed and notification timestamps remain absolute.

agentUpdateInstructions: From v1.11.23, back up data and owner source, then restore and exercise a copy before adopting the update. Update the checkout to v1.11.24, run pnpm install --frozen-lockfile (the checkout pins @runeditrun/rer 0.2.125), and run rer deploy with the same environment and input file. This release adds no migrations. Preserve the original deployment checkout, ownership records and Cloudflare account credentials for guarded rer signin to the app Worker. Name a second copy with --environment and leave LAMP_RESOURCE_PREFIX unset. Preserve the intended mail configuration. The default is MAIL_PROVIDER=none. For enabled email, explicitly select the intended provider. For deliberate MAIL_PROVIDER=none, follow the 1.11.19 notes and docs/deploy.md, including removal of conflicting sender, sending credentials, relay settings, DKIM inputs and secondary mail-provider configuration. Keep the backup and check sign-in, first-run, Settings, published incidents, maintenance start, completion, cancellation and reinstatement, and mail or text delivery where configured. Review imported Sorry templates, audience, affected services and status before publishing. Earlier installations follow the retained release history, including migration 0081 and INSTALLATION_KEY custody. Preserve immutable release records, applied migration history, owner customizations, recorded Worker names and hosting inputs. After successful publication and pointer readback, R2 cleanup keeps the current and previous snapshots. A failed publication deletes nothing. Check the published status page after deployment. Restore technical archives into an empty destination using the source revision that made the archive, then update the restored copy. Run the existing verifier, release validator and affected owner workflows before adopting. Run Edit Run fleet, 2026-11-19.
